entities.summary: Donatas Zavackas is a Lithuanian professional basketball executive and former player, who was the sports director for Wolves Twinsbet of the Lithuanian Basketball League (LKL) and the EuroCup. He played college basketball at University of Pittsburgh. Standing at 6 ft 8 in (2.03 m), he played the power forward position.
